note_tweet.text:
Why aren't language learning apps like Duolingo investing more in local/on-device AI?

Users get a better product (free "premium" features), companies get lower infrastructure costs, and it all works offline with no voice recordings sent to a server!

Fable 5.2 cooked up this pop-up book game that runs LFM3-Omni from @LiquidAI locally in your browser w/ our custom WebGPU kernels. The same model does speech recognition, image understanding, conversation, and text-to-speech. Pretty wild.

It also uses the new html-in-canvas API to make the entire experience more interactive and accessible!

urls.title: Kernels – Hugging Face

data.text:
My favorite part of this project is that it's a perfect example of WebGPU kernels running *outside* of a browser at native speeds! Huge thanks to @wcandillon for building react-native-webgpu! 🤗

Learn more about our WebGPU kernels: https://t.co/QmCbca7MrA

Real-time, local conversational AI is how we will democratize intelligence.

We just ported LFM3-Omni-2B by @LiquidAI to run fully offline on my iPhone 18 Pro Max at ~80 tok/s, powered by custom WebGPU kernels in a React Native app.

Should we release this on the App Store? 👀 https://t.co/HGA8KfBZzI https://t.co/mg8Ybadcnn

urls.description: Run LFM3-Omni-2B locally in the browser on WebGPU
urls.title: LFM3 Omni 2B WebGPU - a Hugging Face Space by LiquidAI

data.text: Try it out yourself! 🤗 https://t.co/nAuDOOVo63

note_tweet.text:
We've just made a breakthrough: the first true omni model running 100% locally in a browser... fully end-to-end, with no separate ASR or TTS models needed.

With custom WebGPU kernels, we're able to run LFM3-Omni-2B at ~280 tok/s on my M4 Max, accepting visual, audio, or text and producing interleaved text and audio tokens. Just 90 ms to the first token and 140 ms to the first audio.

The future of on-device multimodal AI agents is going to be wild.

data.text:
PS: Thanks to @victormustar for laying the groundwork for this project (setting up Pi to run in-browser). I just added the custom model implementation. 🤗

Demo: https://t.co/aYl2jMh3tR

It's insane that you can now run your own coding agent (Pi) w/ LFM3-1.7B *in the browser* at over 300 tok/s on an M4 Max, using custom WebGPU kernels & 4-bit GGUF weights.

No data sent to a server. All your chats stay private.

Try it yourself on Hugging Face 👇 https://t.co/L1ubd5dRVA

note_tweet.text:
Today has been one of the biggest days for open-source AI this year... and it keeps getting better.

@PrismML just released more Ternary Bonsai 2 models on Hugging Face: now in 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B. The 2B reaches up to 500 tok/s on my M4 Max ENTIRELY in the browser with custom WebGPU kernels... that's insane! 🤯

At ~1.8 bits per weight, the language-model weights are just 430MB for 2B and 950MB for 4B (plus ~365MB for the 8-bit vision weights). The future of local agentic AI is going to be wild.

Try out the demo yourself 👇
